# Payload Crowdin Sync — LLM entrypoint
#
# This file is intended for tools/agents that ingest documentation repositories.
# It points to the highest-signal pages in this docs site.

## What is this?
`payload-crowdin-sync` is a Payload CMS plugin that turns nested documents into compact HTML and JSON files for Crowdin translators, then writes translations back into Payload. File count stays low. Fields that are not translatable stay in the CMS.
